label: Auction redesigned — two live tabs. FA Auction and Expired-Rookie are now separate tabs: each shows live lots (tap Bid), the eligible/available pool with search, plus FAA team budgets and roster needs. Bid or Nominate in-app when an auction is on; when it's off the tab is a clean read-only pool. Stale phantom lots are gone. A one-tap "On MFL ↗" fallback stays on every card.
